name_story.story: Samira can be understood through the Arabic form سَمِيرَة, whose central sense is samira; evening companion (feminine). Samira is Arabic سَمِيرَة (Samīra), the feminine of سَمِير, denoting a companion in evening talk.

faq.a: Samira is associated with the Arabic form سَمِيرَة, whose core sense is samira; evening companion (feminine).

faq.q: What is the origin of Samira?
faq.a: Samira is associated with Arabic. Samira is Arabic سَمِيرَة (Samīra), the feminine of سَمِير, denoting a companion in evening talk.
Yes — the underlying form سَمِيرَة is Arabic.
Samira can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Samira should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Samīra is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Samira mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Samira is rendered سمیرہ and carries the sense سمیرہ، رات کی ساتھی.

faq.q: What does Samira mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Samira is rendered سمیره and carries the sense سمیره، هم‌صحبت شب.
A romanized syllable approximation is sa-mi-ra. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Samira?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Samira, samira. Script forms are سميره, سمیره, سمیرہ, سَمِيرَة, समीरा.

faq.q: Is Samira a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
